note: The six live weather layers. Colour scales are FITTED at runtime to the values on screen (shared by both sides in Compare); defaults below are only first-paint values.
rangeFit: lo = floor((min − pad)/step)·step, hi = ceil((max + pad [+3.5 if the layer has projections])/step)·step; pad = 10% of span (or 1); step = 1 for decimal layers, else 5 (10 if span > 50); rain/wind/PM2.5 never below 0; humidity never above 100.
swatch: Menu swatch = conic gradient of the ramp stops from 20% upward with a soft white highlight top-left (see mockups).

layers.label: Air temperature
layers.effectNote: Smooth colour field + contour lines every 0.5/1/2 °C (span <=6 / <=14 / more). Every 2nd step is a major line (1.3dp, 62% white); minor lines dashed 3/4dp at 30% white and drift slowly.

layers.label: Ground temperature
layers.effectNote: No colour field. A grid of dots every 9dp, radius 0.9→4.0dp and colour from the ramp; a soft warm scan band sweeps down slowly. Use the 0–7 cm soil layer everywhere so past and present compare like for like.

layers.label: Rainfall · last 30 days

live.window: sum of the 30 past days (past_days=30, exclude today)

past.daily: precipitation_sum over the 30 days before the date

layers.effectNote: Soft fractal-noise clouds whose density follows live cloud cover and drift with the mean wind; clouds darken where the 30-day total is high. NO falling rain streaks (removed at the owner’s request).

layers.label: Relative humidity
layers.effectNote: Broad, slow, low-contrast mist; density = clamp((RH−35)/65).

layers.label: Wind speed
layers.effectNote: 900–2400 particles advected on interpolated u/v (u = −s·sin θ, v = −s·cos θ; θ = direction wind comes FROM), fading trails (keep 95.5% per frame), coloured by speed in 7 buckets, lifetime 60–150 frames.

layers.label: PM2.5 air pollution
layers.effectNote: Fine warm haze (density = PM2.5 / scale max) plus ~700 slow particulates drifting with the wind.
